title: Prove, close and release AISH work
description: Use when AISH job work must be proven, closed or released (evidência, encerrar): delivery artifacts, DoD audit, findings, execution packs, release packages (pacote de release: create, approve, claim, deploy, complete), requeue, disposition, lineage. Not for creating jobs (use lpm-aish-jobs).
doneWhen: The DoD audit passed right before closure, evidence is preserved (artifacts/pack attached to the activity), and any release has a completion receipt plus authenticated smoke evidence.
authorityCeiling: Artifacts, audits and packs are [A]; findings, release create/claim, requeue and repairs are [C]; release approval is [O] (managing human only).
jobs: register the Playwright screenshot and video as delivery artifacts of AISH job <jobId>
rode a auditoria de Definition of Done da atividade <issueId> e diga o que falta
open a blocking finding: the test report of job <jobId> is missing assertions
posso fechar a atividade do AISH? feche com a evidência do job
export the execution pack of job <jobId> and attach it to the activity
crie o pacote de release de staging do job <jobId> e peça a aprovação do dono
claim the approved release <releaseId>, deploy it and record the receipt
requeue the dead-lettered automation delivery of job <jobId>
marque o job concluído como superseded e repare a linhagem do job órfão
encerrar os jobs do AISH que sobraram na fila

notFor.when: creating, approving or dispatching AISH jobs, execution plans, sessions or checkpoints
starting a runner, leasing a job or submitting job evidence from a host
funding a job, budgets, pools or a financial circuit breaker
an activity not run by the AISH factory (commit trailer, attachments, closure)
approving or delivering a roadmap item lifecycle gate
evidence from WhatsApp or an intake protocol
what the code says, with no AISH job to prove
a project health or integrity review with no repair
deploying or rolling back the LPM product itself

sharedRefs.name: idempotency-and-retries
sharedRefs.loadWhen: after a timeout, before a retry

references.loadWhen: playbook evidence: register a screenshot, video, test report or runner-published file as a delivery artifact of an AISH job
playbook automation: refresh the release-readiness brief of an AISH job, or recover its dead-lettered automation delivery
playbook close: run the DoD audit of an AISH factory activity and close it, or answer "can I close it?"
playbook finding: block the closure of an AISH factory activity on a verified defect, or resolve a fixed one
playbook pack: collect, export and attach the execution pack of one AISH job to its activity
playbook release-approve: approve one sealed AISH release package on the workspace owner's own order, or send the owner the decision request
playbook release-create: create the sealed release package of a deploy-gated AISH plan node; it never deploys
playbook release-deploy: deploy an approved AISH release once and record its receipt
playbook release-smoke: run the authenticated smoke of a succeeded AISH release, record it as pipeline evidence and attach it to the activity

codex.shortDescription: Prove, close and release LPM AISH work with DoD evidence
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-aish-delivery to prove and close the AISH work of LPM activity <issueId>.
